title: PowerShell Wrong-Root False-Commit - forensic + fix
incident_source: Noah.Physical pasted a PowerShell transcript captured live on OBS.
findings: Script was PASTED into a PowerShell prompt from C:\WINDOWS\system32, so $PSScriptRoot / $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path were empty and the repo root resolved to system32.
Operator Home tried to write to C:\WINDOWS\system32\ui\operator_home.html and failed (Access Denied / path not found).
Despite the failed write, the script reported success (false-positive 'committed' reporting).
Manifest counts were 0 because the script read from the wrong directory.
Stale 7777 process PID 37000 (python G:\My Drive\HawkesNest LLC\ORACLE.AI\oracle_server.py --port 7777) was identified and killed.

bugs_addressed.BUG_001: ORACLE.ps1 refuses to run if the resolved root lacks repo markers (oracle_server.py, core\runtime_config.py, ui).
bugs_addressed.BUG_002: Operator Home write wrapped in try/catch; success printed only if the file wrote AND exists with non-zero length; non-zero exit (4) on failure.
bugs_addressed.BUG_003: Pasted execution mitigated: empty $PSScriptRoot now self-heals to C:\Oracle\ORACLE.AI-runtime when present, else hard-fails with guidance to run the saved file.
bugs_addressed.BUG_005: Layer-7 HTTP health check (Test-Http) gates 'runtime alive'; a layer-4 TCP-open-only port is shown as 'port open but app NOT responding', not online.
bugs_addressed.BUG_006: Stale cloud-sync runtime detection: 7777 owned by a G:\My Drive path is labeled STALE and never treated as ORACLE.

verification: Ran patched ORACLE.ps1 -Report from C:\WINDOWS\system32 cwd via -File: resolved repo root correctly, manifest counts 10/7 (not 0), exit 0.
Layer-7 result: 7781 UP (answering /api/mode), 7777 DOWN (stale killed), 7778 DOWN, 11434 UP.
Guard logic test: root=system32 -> REFUSE (all markers missing); root=repo -> ALLOW; empty $PSScriptRoot -> self-heal to repo.
operating_rule: Do not paste path-sensitive scripts into a prompt. Run the saved file from the repo: ORACLE_HOME.bat or powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Oracle\ORACLE.AI-runtime\ORACLE.ps1.
holes: The exact pasted transcript text was not re-captured into the repo; findings are transcribed from Noah.Physical's forensic thread pass.
Some transcript references (evict_stale_runtime.ps1, 'Operator Home Snapshot Committed') may be from a separate script variant; the same hardening was applied to the canonical ORACLE.ps1.
Token origin is AI-authored (Claude Code) under Noah.Physical authority; pending Noah.Physical canon approval.
required_review: Noah.Physical confirm fixes; re-run launcher from Desktop ORACLE icon
